eligibility: Precommitted prediction, valid identity, rowid, timestamps and SHA
Frozen prefix only; no retrospective predictions
horizon: First submission of reserved attempt; response delay is not a retention horizon

metrics: ROC AUC and AP(error) only when both outcomes exist
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired descriptive differences; no independent-trial superiority interval from repeated attempts
evaluation.cohort: All precommitted forecasts in exported snapshot; not a preregistered delayed/novel assessment cohort

missing_data: Absent stays absent; invalid integrity fails run; pending and ineligible targets explicitly unscored

later_phase.recall: Separate FSRS-aligned target and preregistered delayed probes required
later_phase.novel_question_evaluation: Items must be reserved before exposure and all consumers blocked
later_phase.causal_interventions: Separate prospective randomized/counterbalanced N-of-1 protocol required

start_stop.start: User opens normal question session deliberately; preparation must be confirmed before answer
start_stop.stop: End session using existing UI; never delete pending journal or answered history

local_evaluation.export: Existing loopback prospective-export endpoint with admin token; never share token/raw export or commit it
local_evaluation.scope: Local read-only snapshot evaluation; source label/hash does not establish authenticity
